reviews.comment: Dr. Sprekeler is easily best professor that I have ever taken. Although Math 308 is typically a fairly difficult class due to the sheer amount of material packed into it, Dr. Sprekeler clearly explained and motivated all of the material and also provided a great theoretical basis for the subject. He is also always accessible to talk in/out of class

Dr. Sprekeler is awesome! His lectures are in-depth but clear, and he pretty much tells you what will be on each exam beforehand. He even showed real-world applications with linear algebra! Homework (7 total for the semester) is relatively short and worth 30% overall, and he is very approachable if you need help. TAKE HIM!

Yes. I was in his first class ever at A&M. Explains things so clearly for a 400 level math. Joked with us in class. Cheat sheet for exams and final. Questions were straight forward. Partial credit. Gave starter code for the HW. Would take again in a heartbeat.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class
